summary: Iter26 (Pratinjau Impor + Ekspor Bank Soal + gambar_pembahasan): Backend 10/10 pytest pass. All three new endpoints work correctly — POST /api/admin/questions/import/preview (CSV/XLSX/ZIP), POST /api/admin/questions/import/validate, POST /api/admin/tryouts/{id}/questions/import-rows. ZIP images for both 'gambar' and 'gambar_pembahasan' are uploaded and raw/question.explanation_image_url is set to /api/question-images/... URLs. GET /api/admin/question-bank/export returns xlsx with _TPL_HEADERS + sumber_tryout column; re-importing the exported file via preview yields all rows valid (invalid=0). Legacy /api/admin/tryouts/{id}/questions/import still works. Templates (CSV + XLSX) both include gambar_pembahasan column. bidang defaults to tryout.subject on insert when missing. UI TryoutBuilder import flow verified end-to-end on preview URL: file upload via data-testid=import-file opens import-preview-dialog with import-valid-count '2 siap' / import-invalid-count '1 bermasalah' and import-row-{i}/import-row-status-{i} cells; import-row-edit-2 opens import-row-editor (row-edit-text/row-edit-correct), row-edit-save revalidates (invalid→0); import-row-remove-0 removes a row and recounts; import-confirm triggers import and closes dialog. QuestionBankDialog export: question-bank-export downloads bank_soal_semua.xlsx (7893 bytes) using current filters.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_admin._normalize_rows unifies image field aliases (gambar/image/image_url and gambar_pembahasan/explanation_image/explanation_image_url) — good DRY handling for CSV header variations.
_upload_row_images rewrites ZIP-embedded images to /api/question-images URLs so preview rows round-trip through validate without needing the ZIP again.
_insert_rows backfills bidang from tryout.subject when missing — matches spec; verified via test_import_rows_bidang_defaults_to_subject.
question_bank_export reuses _TPL_HEADERS and appends sumber_tryout; re-import validated (test_export_reimportable_all_valid) — single source of truth preserved.
ImportPreviewDialog.doImport filters data.rows by ok before POST — correctly imports only valid rows even if user leaves some invalid rows in table.
ImportPreviewDialog revalidate() calls /admin/questions/import/validate after edit/remove so warnings/errors stay fresh.
QuestionBankDialog.exportXlsx uses responseType:'blob' and Content-Disposition filename — downloads work correctly in browser.
No ObjectId leakage observed in question-bank endpoints (proj with _id:0).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of flows (preview, edit, remove, import, export)
